observed_behavior: A freshly completed adopted plan became invalid after its status-directory move because the completed-plan validator rechecked historical certificate paths against the current filesystem.
expected_behavior: Completed plans retain accepted historical state across the required lifecycle move; active work continues to require fresh current inputs.
causal_mechanism: The completed-plan branch used the mutable current-input projection instead of replaying the already accepted historical checkpoint chain. Relocation removed the old evidence paths without changing accepted history.

anti_pattern.structural_description: A historical inspection boundary is evaluated using a live authorization predicate.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: A legitimate namespace move is misclassified as unfinished accepted work.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Historical acceptance and current-input authorization are distinct typed results; current freshness remains enforced for live work.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Reuse canonical checkpoint replay and accepted projection for a narrow historical result; use it only for completed-plan validation. Preserve the current-input projection unchanged and decouple fixture sources from the active plan locator.

applicability_conditions: Completed records contain an accepted obligation checkpoint chain.
Evidence paths can relocate during the configured successful-completion transition.
known_non_matches: Active current-input projection correctly reports relocated proof as stale.
Incomplete or invalidated accepted history remains incomplete.
confirmation_evidence: tmp/archive-boundary-before.log: Fresh completion succeeded before relocation; completed-plan validation threw CAMPAIGN_OBLIGATION_INCOMPLETE after relocation.
tmp/archive-correction-focused.log: Three focused typed plan-content tests passed, including historical completion after relocation, stale current inputs and rejection of invalidated history.
regression_proofs: tests/campaign-plan-contents.test.ts: accepted plan history survives a status directory move
tmp/archive-boundary-after.log: identical one-variable filesystem probe passed
